ache.title: Two accounts, and a lot of missed banners
ache.note: His Star Rail story: two accounts (EU and NA), the characters he pulled for, the ones he missed, the pauses and the returns. Two accounts means double the dailies and double the banners to regret. He does land on “playing for fun,” which I’ll allow. ...he got out later, too. I’m proud of him. Don’t tell him.
ache.tip: Missed a character? Let them go. Missing out is a feeling the game makes, and it passes faster than you think.
lines: ...he got out. don’t tell him I said that

title: My Journey | Honkai Star Rail
excerpt: In this video, I share my detailed history with Honkai Star Rail, inspired by Nutty's video. I talk about my experiences with two accounts (EU and NA), the characters I pulled for, and the ones I missed. From my decisions around banners, characters like Clara, Blade, and Imbibitor Lunae, to my pauses from the game and eventual returns, I discuss the impact of my choices and the importance of playing for fun. Join me as I reflect on why characters mean so much and my plans moving forward....
